prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a rear-end collision in Baytown, Texas, and has wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1082; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the rear-end collision in Baytown, Texas. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather just keep it to what happened, if that's okay.

Q: That's fine. Can you describe where you were driving and what the traffic was like when the collision occurred?

A: I was heading down the main road toward the shopping center. Traffic had slowed to a crawl near the light, so I was stopped behind a sedan with my foot on the brake.

Q: Did you notice anything behind you before the impact?

A: Not really. I glanced in the mirror and saw headlights, but it looked like they were still a good distance back. Then there was a hard jolt from behind and my head snapped forward and back.

Q: Did you have your seatbelt fastened?

A: Yes, I always do.

Q: Did you or anyone in your vehicle need medical attention at the scene?

A: The paramedics came and checked me out. My left wrist was hurting badly, and I couldn't grip anything. They said it might be broken, so they put it in a splint and took me to the emergency room.

Q: Have you received a diagnosis since then?

A: Yes. The doctors confirmed a fracture in the wrist. I have a cast now and I'm going to see a specialist for a follow-up.

Q: Have you been able to return to work or your usual activities?

A: Not fully. I'm right-handed, but I can't lift or type the way I used to, so I've had to adjust.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Just that I'd like to get my car repaired and get this wrist healed as soon as possible.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
